description: Your robots and the ones you can play against. Without robotId: yours (with recent jobs); among "arena", every robot you can put in a practice match, house robots with their tier (entry, middle, top) and a hint; among "deleted", the robots you deleted, restorable for 30 days. With robotId: view "project" (default) gives its saved revision, its draft (uncommitted changes), files and staging; "draft" gives the draft alone: its base, the robot's latest revision, whether it is behind, its changes and conflicts, and what the latest revision changed since the base; "file" reads a file of the draft (revisionId for a saved revision), whole or by startLine and endLine, with its sha256 and size; "search" finds a pattern in the draft's files, line by line; "revisions" lists saved revisions; "build" gives its latest build (or jobId's) with diagnostics, and with offset a page of the log.

context.description: view search: lines around each match

limit.description: Rows a page holds at most (default 50); fewer when rows would pass the size limit

path.description: view file: the file; view search: a file or directory to search

pattern.description: view search: the text to find

regex.description: view search: pattern is a regular expression

revisionId.description: view file: a saved revision instead of the draft

tier.description: among arena: only house robots of this tier

name: robots
